title: PROPHESY INTO YOUR DAY BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES THIS MORNING
text: Hallelujah. Father, we thank you. We thank you, Lord. Spirit of the living God, we welcome you into this moment, into this hour, into this atmosphere. You are the reason we are gathered. You are the reason we open our mouths. You are the reason anything meaningful will happen in this place today. So, Lord, breathe on these words. Breathe on every ear that will receive this word, every heart that has tuned in this morning, every spirit that is hungry, every life that is at a crossroads, breathe on them, Lord. Let the wind of heaven move through this [music] word like fire through dry bones in Jesus' name. Amen. Now, I want you to settle into this moment. I want you to understand something before I begin. The fact that you are awake this morning is not accidental. You did not wake up because your alarm went off. You did not wake up because the sun rose. You woke up because the God who numbers your days and orders your steps decided that you had more to do, [music] more to become, more to receive, more to release. The mercy of God is new every morning, not just as a poetic sentiment, not just as a song we sing, [music] but as a literal daily fresh dispensation of divine favor released over your life at the moment you open your eyes. Hear me. Every morning that you are alive is a prophetic statement from heaven. It means your story is not over. It means the enemy did not have the final say. It means God looked at your situation and said, "Not yet. Not yet. This one still has a destiny to fulfill." So, this morning I want to talk to you about prophesying into your day, about opening your mouth, about releasing something from the realm of the spirit into the natural course of the hours that stretch before you. I am preaching to somebody. You are not just going to drift through today. You are not going to merely survive today. You are going to speak to today. You are going to command today. You are going to shape today before today shapes you. Turn with me in your spirit, even if you cannot turn your Bible in this moment, to the book of Job chapter 22 and verse 28. This is a foundational scripture and I want you to lock it in your spirit. It says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways. Thou shalt also decree a thing." There is a shalt in that verse that most people rush past. It is not thou mayest decree, >> [music] >> it is not thou couldest decree. If you are spiritual enough, it is thou shalt. It is a directive. It is an instruction embedded in the architecture of covenant. God is saying to you, "The decree is your responsibility. The establishment is mine. You bring the word, I bring the power." You release the declaration, I release the manifestation. This is the partnership of the kingdom and it begins every single morning. Now, I need you to understand the geography of your day. When you wake up in the morning, the hours of that day are like a field. They are unplanted. They are unwritten. And everything that will grow in that field is determined by what is sown into it. If you wake up and immediately receive fear, you have planted fear. If you wake up and immediately receive anxiety, you have watered the [music] soil of your day with anxiety and by evening you will be harvesting exactly what you sowed. But if you wake up and you open your mouth and you speak the word of God into the atmosphere of your day, you have planted the incorruptible seed of divine intention into the hours that God has given you. This is not mysticism. This is not positive thinking. This is the theology of a new creation. Hear me. You are made in the image and the likeness of the God who spoke the world into existence. When God wanted light, he did not look for a switch. He spoke. He said, "Let there be." And there was. You carry that same creative capacity in your voice, activated and empowered by the indwelling Holy Spirit. The Apostle Paul writing to the church at Rome in chapter 4 and verse 17, describing the nature of the God we serve, says God calls those things which be not as though they were. And the context of that verse is the life of Abraham. Abraham was a man with no child, and yet God renamed him father of many nations. He was calling things that were not as though they were. And the writer of Hebrews in chapter 11 tells us that Abraham staggered not at the promise. He staggered not. He looked at his body, he looked at Sarah, he looked at the natural impossibility, and he chose to believe that the God who spoke was more real than everything he could see. And beloved, this is the school you have been enrolled in this morning, the school of calling things that are not as though they were. I want to say something here that is important. When you prophesy into your day, you are not in denial of reality. You are in defiance of limitation. There is a difference. To be in denial means you pretend the problem does not exist. But to prophesy is to stand in the presence of the problem, look [music] it in the eye, and declare that there is a God in heaven who has already settled the matter. It is not ignorance, it is revelation knowledge. It is what Paul calls in the book of Philippians chapter 4, the peace that passes understanding. Not the peace that comes when everything makes sense, but the peace that comes when you know whose hands hold the outcome. David understood this. I keep coming back to David because David is a masterclass in prophesying into your circumstances. In [music] Psalm 27:1, he opens with a declaration, not a request. He does not begin by saying, "Lord, please be my light." He says, "The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear?" He's speaking into being the experiential reality of what he knows to be spiritually true. And watch what happens as you read through that Psalm. His confidence does not decrease as the psalm progresses, [music] it increases. By the time he gets to verse 13, he's saying, "I had fainted unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living." He's essentially saying, "I am not done yet. I am still here." And what he means is that his prophetic declarations kept him alive through the warfare. Your words carry life. Your words carry instruction to angels. Your words carry direction to the events that are lining up to meet you today. Now, let me be very clear about what it means to prophesy into your day, specifically. It is not merely quoting scripture, though that is powerful. It is not merely positive confession, though there is truth in aligning your words with God's word. To prophesy into your day is to come before God in the early hours and allow the Holy Spirit to give you intelligence about that day. It is to say, "Holy Spirit, what does heaven say about this day? What is the purpose of God for me in the next 24 hours? What warfare is assigned against me [music] and what victory has been prepared?" And then you take that intelligence and you declare it, you speak it. You release it into the atmosphere of your morning. This is the pattern that Jesus modeled in the Gospel of Mark chapter 1 verses 35 to 37. The scripture says that in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed. In the morning, before the demands of the day, before the crowds, before the miracles, Jesus established spiritual jurisdiction over his day [music] through prayer and communion with the Father. If the Son of God needed to do this, hear me. If the Son of God with all wisdom and power chose to set the spiritual tone of his day before it began, how much more do you and I need to learn this discipline? How much more do we need to resist the temptation of beginning our day with social media, with news, with destruction, and instead begin with the word and with [music] prayer? Father, I pause here. Holy Spirit, I am aware that there are people receiving this word who have been drifting. People whose mornings have been filled with everything except you. And Lord, I am not standing here to condemn them because your word says there is no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, >> [music] >> but I am standing here to call them back. Lord, call them back to the altar of morning. Call them back to the habit of setting the spiritual tone of their day. And Lord, for those who have been consistent, who have been faithful, who have been crying out in the early hours, Lord, reward their faithfulness. Let them see the manifestation of everything they have been declaring. [music] Let breakthrough come to the consistent intercessors. Let open doors [music] meet the faithful prophetic voices in Jesus' name. Father, stir up the gift that is in them. Stir it up. Stir up the gift. [music] For God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Let power rise in them this morning, Lord. Supernatural power. Uncommon grace. Unusual favor. In the name of Jesus. Now, I want to prophesy over you. I need you to receive this. I am speaking to the person who has been afraid of what this day holds. You have been looking at your calendar with dread. You have been looking at your appointments with fear. You have been thinking about that meeting, that medical report, that financial situation, that relationship, and everything in you has wanted to shrink back. But hear me right now. Thus says the Lord, "This day is already in my hands. I have gone before you. The places you will walk today, I have already walked. The people you will encounter today, I have already prepared the interaction. The words that need to be spoken, I will put in your mouth. The doors that need to be opened, I have already unlocked them. You shall go into this day and you shall come out of it in my favor. Not because you are perfect, not because you have done everything right, but because you are mine, because my name is upon you. Because the blood of my [music] son has sealed your destiny and no enemy assignment can unseal what the blood has sealed. I declare over you that this day will not end the way it began. There are people receiving this word who will enter this morning in a [music] state of lack and encounter a divine supply before nightfall. There are people who are going to receive a phone call today that will change the course of the next season of your life. There are people who have been in a waiting period, people who have been told no by men and closed doors and systems, and I am prophesying to you by the spirit of the living God, your yes is arriving. Your yes is arriving. The waiting has not been wasted. Every money you spent in prayer, every tear you cried in the secret place, every scripture you declared over your life, even when you did not feel like it, heaven has been recording it and the record of your faithfulness is now triggering the release of your reward. Now, I want to deal with [music] warfare because I need you to understand that every great day is contested. Every meaningful breakthrough is contested. The enemy does not mind you being alive as long as you are not dangerous. He does not mind you going to church as long as you are not changing anything. But the moment you begin to understand your prophetic [music] authority, the moment you begin to open your mouth and speak into your circumstances, you become a threat and threats are targeted. This is why Paul says in Ephesians chapter 6 verses 10 to 12, "Be strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. This is not metaphor. This is spiritual geography. There are systems of darkness that are assigned to resist your advancement. There are spiritual forces that work overtime to ensure that your day is filled with frustration, destruction, confusion, and delay. And the answer is not to be afraid of them. The answer is to speak to them. The answer is to open your mouth and address the darkness with the light of the word of God. If you have been blessed by this word so far, I want to pause and ask you to do something. Share this ministration with someone who needs a breakthrough today. Someone in your contacts, someone in your family, someone in your circle who has been struggling, who has been discouraged, who has forgotten that they have authority in their mouth. Send it to them. Because you never know whose morning you will rescue by the simple act of being a carrier of this word. Now, we are going into intercession. We are not done. Come with me. Holy Spirit, we engage the atmosphere. We engage the spiritual terrain of this day. Right now, in the name of Jesus, every spirit of delay that has been assigned to frustrate the plans and purposes of God for your life, we address you directly. You have no authority. The blood of Jesus has stripped you of your authority. The resurrection of Jesus Christ has dismantled every legal claim that darkness had over the lives of the children of God. You shall not delay them. You shall not divert them. You shall not confuse them. Every plan of the enemy to send a wrong word, a wrong [music] report, a wrong meeting into the path of the people of God today, we cancel it. We sever it at the root. We speak the fire of God into every agenda of darkness [music] that has been scheduled against the destiny of the men and women who are crying out in prayer this morning. We pray for the favor of God to go before them like a shield. Psalm 5:12 says, "Thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield." Lord, let that shield of favor be tangible today. Let people feel your hand upon them. Let them walk into rooms and something shifts. Let them open their mouths and the right words come. Let the supernatural wisdom of God be available to them in every decision they face today. We pull down every stronghold of the mind. We rebuke every lying imagination that has painted a picture of defeat over their future. We replace every lie with the truth of your word, Lord. We declare that they are more than conquerors through him that loved us. That neither death nor life nor angels nor principalities nor powers [music] nor things present nor things to come nor height nor depth nor any other creature shall be able to separate them from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. We pray for the children. Lord, cover the [music] children. Every child going to school today, every young person navigating systems and environments that are hostile to their faith, Lord, station your angels around them. Let your peace garrison their hearts and minds. Let no weapon that is fashioned against them prosper today. We pray for the marriages. Lord, we speak life into marriages that have been under pressure. We speak communication, understanding, grace, and divine wisdom into homes that have been experiencing friction. Lord, restore what the enemy has stolen. Rebuild what discouragement has torn down. We pray for finances. Lord, we speak to financial systems. We speak to businesses. We speak to employment opportunities. Lord, open doors of supernatural increase. Let your people not lack any good thing. For the earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof, and you have said that you will supply all their need according to your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. We speak to health. Every person who woke up this morning with pain in their body, with sickness in their physical frame, we do not accept it as permanent. [music] We declare that by the stripes of Jesus you are healed. The healing that was purchased at Calvary is available for your body right now. We command every infirmity to release its grip. We command every system of the body to function according to the original design of God. We speak health, wholeness, strength, and vitality into the bodies of every listener in the name of Jesus. And we pray for clarity of purpose. Lord, there are people who are disoriented. They do not know what to do next. They have been at a fork in the road for too long. Lord, in the mercy of your name, send direction. Send a word. Send a sign. Send a confirmation. Let the path that you have chosen become unmistakably clear to them today. For you have said in Isaiah chapter 30 verse 21 that your ears shall hear a word behind you saying, "This is the way, walk in it." When you turn to the right hand and when you turn to the left. Lord, let that voice be audible in their spirit today. Let the inward witness of the Holy Spirit guide them into the exact will of God for this day [music] and for this season. Let me bring you into this final charge. You are not going into this day as a victim. You are not going in confused, afraid, or unprepared. You are going in clothed in the armor of God, saturated in the word of God, filled with the spirit of God, and covered by the blood of Jesus. That is not a small thing. That is the most powerful positioning any human being can have. And from this position of authority, I want you to go into this day speaking. Go in speaking over your family. Speak life over your children before they leave the house. Speak blessing over your spouse. Speak prosperity over your business. Speak wisdom over your decisions. Speak peace over your mind. Speak health over your body. Let your morning not pass without your voice because your voice anointed by the Holy Spirit is the instrument through which heaven reshapes your earthly reality. The word of God in Proverbs chapter 18 verse 21 is not a cliche. It is a spiritual law. Death and life are in the power of the tongue and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof. Every day of your life, you are eating the fruit of your words from the previous days, the previous weeks, the previous years and today you begin to plant a new harvest. [music] Today you plant faith words. Today you plant covenant words. Today you plant prophetic declarations that will grow into testimonies, into miracles, into breakthroughs, into open doors, into divine connections that will shift your story permanently. I release you into this day in the name of Jesus. Go with a shout in your mouth and a praise in your heart. Go with the confidence of a man or a woman who knows that the God of the universe is their shield, their exceedingly great reward, their shepherd, their father, their deliverer and their friend. Go knowing that the same spirit that raised Jesus from the dead is alive inside of you walking, breathing, moving, interceding and empowering you for every moment of this glorious day. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face to shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. This day belongs to you because it belongs to God and you belong to him. Now go and live it for [music] his glory. Amen.
